title: Reconcile entities without implementation-deck references
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can identify Systems, Components, and data entities without implementation-deck references and decide how to reconcile them so the inventory remains connected to the application's feature implementations.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An entity with no implementation-deck reference is identified for reconciliation unless it is explicitly proposed or identified as new against the report's named comparison baseline; newness is never inferred merely from absent references.

For an unreferenced entity that is neither explicitly proposed nor new in the named comparison, the workflow asks the user what to do rather than silently reclassify, delete, or attach it to an arbitrary feature.
The gap exposes the entity's identity, explanation, evidence state, and absence of implementation-deck usages so the user can determine where it belongs.
